# src.store.JobStore
# kaynak: src/store/jobs.py
class JobStore:
    def __init__(self, db_path: str)
    self.db_path
    @classmethod
    def for_store(cls, store: 'Store') -> 'JobStore'
    def close(self) -> None
    @classmethod
    def wait_for_finishing_job(cls, store: 'Store') -> bool
    def writer_busy(self) -> bool
    def mark_stale_running_interrupted(self) -> int
    def reap_stale(self) -> int
    @contextlib.contextmanager
    def exclusive(self, operation: str) -> Iterator[None]
    def rebind(self, db_path: str) -> bool
    def create_running(self, payload: Any, *, job_id: Optional[str] = None, kind: str = DEFAULT_KIND, origin: Optional[Mapping[str, Any]] = None, spec: Optional[Mapping[str, Any]] = None, wait: float = 0.0, purpose: str = JOB_PURPOSE, replace_running: bool = True) -> str
    def request_cancel(self) -> bool
    def cancel(self, job_id: str) -> bool
    def cancel_requested(self, job_id: Optional[str] = None) -> bool
    def poll_cancel(self, job_id: Optional[str] = None) -> bool
    def heartbeat(self, job_id: Optional[str] = None) -> bool
    def update(self, *, status: Optional[str] = None, progress: Optional[int] = None, current_task: Optional[str] = None, append_log: Optional[str] = None, matches_total: Optional[int] = None, matches_done: Optional[int] = None, matches_failed: Optional[int] = None, schedule_empty_seasons: Optional[int] = None, circuit_breaker_triggered: Optional[bool] = None, circuit_breaker_reason: Optional[str] = None, eta_seconds: Optional[float] = None, current_batch: Optional[str] = None, result: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, detail: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, finished: bool = False, job_id: Optional[str] = None, state: Optional[str] = None, error: Optional[Mapping[str, Any]] = None) -> None
    def snapshot(self) -> Dict[str, Any]
    def append_event(self, job_id: str, type: str, data: Optional[Mapping[str, Any]] = None) -> int
    def read_events(self, job_id: str, *, after: int = 0, limit: int = 500) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]
    def announce(self, type: str, data: Mapping[str, Any]) -> Optional[int]
    def list_jobs(self, limit: int = 20) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]
    def get_job(self, job_id: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]
    def get_record(self, job_id: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]
    def list_records(self, limit: int = JOB_HISTORY_LIMIT) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]
    def active_record(self) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]
